mapper.select: SELECT * FROM plans WHERE is_active = TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plans (name, description, duration_minutes, price, capacity, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{durationMinutes}, #{price}, #{capacity}, #{isActive}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE plans SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, duration_minutes = #{durationMinutes}, price = #{price}, capacity = #{capacity}, is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE plans SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
